primary_goal: Pembangunan Platform SaaS White-Label Multi-Tenant Restaurant POS & Self-Order (Santapos)
tech_stack: Next.js 16 (App Router), Express.js 5 API, PostgreSQL / Supabase, Turborepo, pnpm workspaces, Tailwind CSS v3
locked_constraints: Database PostgreSQL murni dengan Row Level Security (RLS) dan filter service-layer wajib di setiap kueri
Tailwind CSS v3 (bukan v4), warna runtime lewat CSS variable yang disuntik sebagai inline style di root
Responsif 3 breakpoint mobile-first: default (<768px), md: (768-1023px), lg: (>=1024px)
Dilarang hardcode brand Sultan Kebab di seluruh codebase; Sultan Kebab hanya demo tenant pertama
Separation of concerns 4-tier: Controller -> Service -> Repository -> Model / Schemas
Pemisahan independen peran Builder dan Reviewer (anti echo-chamber hallucination)
Pencegahan data leak: tenant A dilarang keras dapat membaca atau memutasi data tenant B

subtasks.title: Tahap A: Fondasi Monorepo (pnpm workspaces + Turborepo + packages/shared, ui, config)
Tahap B: Multi-Tenant Engine (migrasi schema tenants, outlets, plans, tenant resolver middleware, data isolation test)
Tahap C: White-Label Branding (dynamic CSS variables theme, dynamic manifest.json, conditional powered-by)
Tahap D: Kesiapan Jual & Onboarding (UMKM onboarding wizard, super admin panel, franchise aggregate overview)
